tagline.hi: The fast, glass-nosed French scout that introduced the Fenestron
tagline.en: The fast, glass-nosed French scout that introduced the Fenestron

summary.hi: The Gazelle is a light five-seat helicopter designed by Sud Aviation and built by Aérospatiale, first flown in 1967. It was the first production helicopter with a Fenestron, a fan-in-fin tail rotor. The SA342M is the French Army (ALAT) anti-tank version: a single Turbomeca Astazou XIV M engine, four HOT wire-guided missiles and a roof sight for the gunner. Upgraded SA342M1 Viviane machines added a thermal night sight and are still in service.
